description: Evaluation questions for the fictional Northwind sample documents in /samples. 'evidence' is a passage copied from the source document; a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it comes from the expected file and page and contains this passage (case and whitespace are ignored). 'key_facts' lists facts a correct answer must contain; each fact is a list of accepted spellings.

questions.question: What are the core working hours?
questions.evidence: Core working hours are 11:00 to 16:00

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.evidence: 24 days of paid annual leave

questions.question: How many unused leave days can I carry over to the next year?
questions.evidence: Up to 6 unused days can be carried over

questions.question: When do carried-over leave days expire?
questions.evidence: remaining days expire on 31 March

questions.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
questions.expected_answer: For absences longer than 2 consecutive days
questions.evidence: a medical certificate is required for absences longer than 2 consecutive days

questions.question: How many days a week am I allowed to work from home?
questions.evidence: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week

questions.question: Who has to approve a fully remote work arrangement?
questions.expected_answer: Both the team lead and the HR department, in writing
questions.evidence: written approval from both the team lead and the HR department

questions.question: How much is the home office allowance for remote employees?
questions.evidence: home office allowance of INR 15,000

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting travel expense claims?
questions.evidence: submitted within 30 days of the trip

questions.question: What is the daily limit for meal reimbursement during business travel?
questions.evidence: reimbursed up to INR 1,500 per day

questions.question: How large is the yearly learning budget per employee?
questions.evidence: annual learning budget of INR 40,000

questions.question: What is the minimum password length for company accounts?
questions.evidence: a password of at least 14 characters

questions.question: Which systems require multi-factor authentication?
questions.expected_answer: Email, source code hosting and the cloud console
questions.evidence: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, source code hosting

questions.question: Who is given hardware security keys?
questions.evidence: Hardware security keys are issued to administrators

questions.question: After how many minutes of inactivity must a company laptop lock?
questions.evidence: lock after 5 minutes of inactivity

questions.question: Am I allowed to copy customer data to a USB drive?
questions.expected_answer: No, copying customer data to personal devices or USB drives is prohibited
questions.evidence: copying customer data to personal devices or USB drives is prohibited

questions.question: How soon must a lost or stolen laptop be reported?
questions.expected_answer: Within 1 hour of discovering the loss
questions.evidence: within 1 hour of discovering the loss

questions.question: How quickly must the on-call security engineer respond to a P1 security incident?
questions.evidence: on-call security engineer to respond within 15 minutes

questions.question: When is the written report for a P1 security incident due?
questions.evidence: a written incident report within 48 hours

questions.question: How should I report a phishing email?
questions.expected_answer: With the Report Phishing button, without forwarding it to colleagues
questions.evidence: reported with the Report Phishing button

questions.question: Who is covered by the group health insurance?
questions.expected_answer: The employee, their spouse and up to two children
questions.evidence: covers the employee, their spouse and up to two children

questions.question: What is the sum insured under the health insurance policy?
questions.evidence: INR 5,00,000 per family per year

questions.question: How long do new joiners have to enrol in health insurance?
questions.evidence: must enrol within 30 days of joining

questions.question: How much paid parental leave do primary caregivers get?
questions.evidence: 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave

questions.question: How long is paternity leave for a secondary caregiver?
questions.expected_answer: 4 weeks of paid leave, taken within 6 months
questions.evidence: Secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks of paid leave

questions.question: How much can I claim each year for a gym membership?
questions.expected_answer: Up to INR 12,000 per year for wellness expenses
questions.evidence: up to INR 12,000 per year for wellness expenses

questions.question: How much does the company contribute to the provident fund?
questions.evidence: contributes 12% of basic salary to the provident fund

questions.question: After how many years of service is gratuity paid?
questions.evidence: Gratuity is paid after 5 years of continuous service

questions.question: When do new employees get their laptop?
questions.evidence: receive their laptop on their first working day

questions.question: How often are laptops replaced?
questions.evidence: Laptops are replaced every 3 years

questions.question: What is the name of the company VPN client?
questions.evidence: The company VPN client is called NorthGate

questions.question: What is the staff Wi-Fi network called?
questions.evidence: The staff Wi-Fi network in all offices is NW-Staff

questions.question: How quickly does IT respond when there is a complete IT outage?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 minutes (treated as an IT P1)
questions.evidence: gets a response within 30 minutes

questions.question: How long are laptop backups kept?
questions.evidence: backups are kept for 90 days

questions.question: How far in advance must flights be booked?
questions.evidence: booked at least 14 days before departure

questions.question: When am I allowed to fly business class?
questions.expected_answer: Only for flights longer than 8 hours
questions.evidence: business class is allowed only for flights longer than 8 hours

questions.question: What is the daily allowance for international trips?
questions.evidence: daily allowance for international travel is USD 75

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night in metro cities?
questions.evidence: capped at INR 7,000 per night in metro cities

questions.question: How many days before an international trip is manager approval needed?
questions.evidence: manager approval at least 21 days before departure

questions.question: Who arranges travel insurance for international trips?
questions.evidence: is arranged by the HR team
